citations.claim: Body 1 sits essentially exactly on waypoint with near-zero velocity just before failure
Body 1 position becomes non-finite at first violating step

counterfactual.change: Disabled controller (enabled true->false); predicts NaN came from controller direction normalization at zero distance to waypoint, so disabling removes failure.

explanation: Controller body 1 converges exactly onto its waypoint by step 2046 (position equals waypoint 9.109,9.226 with speed ~1e-13). On the next step the velocity-error/direction law must normalize a zero displacement vector, producing division-by-zero NaN that propagates to position, velocity and energy at step 2047. Disabling the controller removes the NaN, confirming controller waypoint handling as cause.
vision_note: Steps 2044 to 2046 show stable circles with the red violating body holding near the top center. At step 2047 the red body disappears entirely while the remaining blue bodies jump to lower positions and a green waypoint cross appears.
